text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I brought Tosen Jordan, who hasn't 
been feeling well lately, to pray at the 
shrine...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Nakayama. You here to pray?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, just taking a stroll. Looking 
to see if there's someone around to bet 
with.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you visit a shrine is quite the 
rare sight.
choice_data_list: She seems to not be feeling well lately...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what a coincidence. To be honest, 
I've had a ridiculously bad losing streak 
lately myself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this, you just need a 
win—doesn't matter what it is. ...Hey, 
Jordan. How about a bet with me?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? A bet?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll win and turn my luck around! 
But! If I lose, I'll spiral even worse 
than before! Straight to rock bottom...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what a drag. Who cares about luck 
anyway...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ho... Are you afraid of losing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haa...? I never said anything like that.
choice_data_list:
There's no need to force a confrontation 
anyway.

There's really no need to force a 
competition, either.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, it's not like I can't do it! Fine, 
bring it on!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! That's what I like to hear! As 
for the match... how about guessing 
whether the next visitor to these shrine 
grounds will be a human or an Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, I'm betting on the 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall take the humans. Now, let the 
battle begin--!!

WOOOOOOH-----!! Where the heck are 
youuuu~~~~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Someone's here!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's Ticket-zo-san! Yay! I win~☆

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Found you, Joooordan! I've been 
looking for you! I couldn't wait to tell 
youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this! A present addressed to 
Jordan arrived at our dorm room! In a 
super fashionable boooox!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? Maybe I won it! From that 
online giveaway! Whoa! Good things just 
keep comin'♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?! That's awesome!! Seeing you 
so happy makes me happy too, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. A total defeat... Looks like luck 
was entirely on your side.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh right, are you doing okay? With that 
whole... rock bottom thing, was it...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I ain't the kind of person who needs your 
pity. Heh, this is actually gettin' me 
fired up. Now then, let's see how I crawl 
my way back up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa left looking satisfied. 
Ever since, Tosen Jordan's slump has 
cleared up as if it were all a lie!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, no one appeared in the shrine 
grounds. Dorm curfew is coming up soon...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My mood's totally tanking... Why isn't 
anyone coming? Seriously, no way!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch, fine. We'll call it a draw for 
today. We are definitely settling this 
someday, though."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the showdown was put on hold. Her 
so-called luck remained unchanged, and 
Tosen Jordan stayed in a slump.
